covers.name: 01_reference_composition
covers.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Asset type: finished professional music-video cover, one single opaque landscape image, 16:9, target 1920x1080 or higher same aspect ratio. Not a contact sheet.
Series: NancyLu · world.execute(me); CONTRACT EDITION. Sophisticated Japanese anime screenprint meets hacker editorial graphics. Near-black #080d15, ice-white #f2f5f7, electric-blue #48baff; purple only in the irises and tiny reasoning-slider accent. Fine controlled halftone and print grain, crisp confident contours and flat ink shapes; readable at thumbnail size.
Character invariants: clearly the SAME adult NancyLu as the identity reference, cool aloof neutral closed mouth, narrow PURPLE eyes, long split hair WHITE on viewer-left and BLACK on viewer-right, pointed cat ears with blue interiors, curled white ahoge, small white skull clip on the black hair, black high-collar contract outfit with triangular silver pendant and shoulder buckles. All visible normal skin is ICE WHITE, not blue or peach. Preserve her face identity. No smile, no youthful/chibi proportions.
Text must be exact and graphically typeset, not approximate glyphs. Keep principal text inside 5% safe margins. No watermarks, platform UI, orange, red or pink, no additional characters, no false 4K/token/frame-count badges, no signature. Keep glitch slices away from principal letters and eye anatomy.
Input images: image 1 is COMPOSITION/graphic-layout reference ONLY, do not retain its heroine, flower, orange palette or original small slogan. Image 2 is NancyLu IDENTITY and outfit reference. Image 3 is the approved PV's WHITE SKIN / PURPLE EYES / print-style reference, not the layout.
Primary request: reinterpret the reference video cover with NancyLu. Extreme close crop across her face; one large sharply drawn purple eye around the left third looks directly toward viewer, black and white hair spreads through the frame. Retain identifiable sliver of cat ear/skull clip and her characteristic fringe, without needing the whole head. A tiny code-grid glint inside iris, not covering it. Right half dominated by 3 offset near-black rectangular title bars, with huge white monospaced lettering and restrained electric-blue registration shadow:
line 1 "world."
line 2 "execute"
line 3 "(me);"
Below, one small blue or black label reads "NancyLu / CONTRACT EDITION".
Her ice-white cheek and white hair must remain distinct from black hair via crisp contour and sparse blue shadows. Deep near-black code-text fragments behind hair gaps, a few bold blue angular wedges, 3–4 deliberate horizontal print slices at edges. Strong graphic balance, energetic but elegant, faithful to the cover's hierarchy. Song title is the largest element.
